# Flashing

## Downloading uuu tool (linux)

```
sudo apt-get install libusb-1.0.0-dev libzip-dev libbz2-dev

# Tool:
wget -c https://download.technexion.com/development_resources/development_tools/installer/imx-mfg-uuu-tool.zip
unzip imx-mfg-uuu-tool.zip
```

## Confirming

Will only show up when DIP switch are in right position.

```
$ ./imx-mfg-uuu-tool/uuu/linux64/uuu -lsusb
uuu (Universal Update Utility) for nxp imx chips -- libuuu_1.5.179-12-g1afbe34

Connected Known USB Devices
        Path     Chip    Pro     Vid     Pid     BcdVersion      Serial_no
        ====================================================================
        1:5      MX7D    SDP:    0x15A2 0x0076   0x0001
```

## Flashing

Takes a few minutes.

### Ubuntu

```
sudo imx-mfg-uuu-tool/uuu/linux64/uuu -b emmc_imx7_img imx-mfg-uuu-tool/imx7/pico-imx7/imx7-SPL imx-mfg-uuu-tool/imx7/pico-imx7/imx7-u-boot.img ubuntu-22.04
```

### Yocto

#### With original SPL and uboot

```
# Decompress?
bzip2 -f -d -k imx-image-multimedia-pico-imx7-20250130195142.rootfs.wic.bz2

sudo imx-mfg-uuu-tool/uuu/linux64/uuu -b emmc_imx7_img imx-mfg-uuu-tool/imx7/pico-imx7/imx7-SPL imx-mfg-uuu-tool/imx7/pico-imx7/imx7-u-boot.img tmp/deploy/images/pico-imx7/imx-image-multimedia-pico-imx7.wic.bz2/*
```

#### With own SPL

To verify, doesn't work.

```

# Flash
sudo ./imx-mfg-uuu-tool/uuu/linux64/uuu -b emmc_imx7_img tmp/deploy/images/pico-imx7/SPL tmp/deploy/images/pico-imx7/u-boot.img tmp/deploy/images/pico-imx7/imx-image-multimedia-pico-imx7.wic.bz2/*
```

## Windows

```
uuu\windows64\uuu.exe -b emmc_imx7_img imx-mfg-uuu-tool\imx7\pico-imx7\imx7-SPL imx-mfg-uuu-tool\imx7\pico-imx7\imx7-u-boot.img ubuntu-22.04
```
